description: This file is a test suite for the NetworkManager implementation in a C++ project, utilizing Google Test for unit testing. It tests various network management functionalities such as interface status, IP settings, WiFi operations, and external integrations through mocks.

classes.name: NetworkManagerTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for setting up and tearing down the environment for NetworkManager unit tests, using Google Test framework.

methods.name: RegisteredMethods
methods.description: Test that the expected methods are registered and available in the JSON RPC handler.

methods.name: LogLevel
methods.description: Test setting and getting the log level for network manager.

methods.name: GetAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Test retrieval of network interfaces, mocking interface list data.

methods.name: GetAvailableInterfaces_Failed
methods.description: Test failure scenario for getting available interfaces.

methods.name: GetPrimaryInterface_BothInterfacesDown
methods.description: Test case when no active interfaces are found.

methods.name: SetInterfaceState
methods.description: Test enabling or disabling network interfaces and verifying the IARM calls.

methods.name: SetInterfaceState_Failed
methods.description: Test failure scenario when setting interface state.

methods.name: GetInterfaceState_wifi
methods.description: Test retrieving the state of a WiFi interface.

methods.name: GetInterfaceState_eth0
methods.description: Test retrieving the state of an Ethernet interface.

methods.name: GetIPSettings
methods.description: Test retrieval of IP configuration details for an interface, with both IPv4 and IPv6 cases.

methods.name: GetIPSettings_IPv6
methods.description: Test retrieval of IPv6 IP settings.

methods.name: GetIPSettings_NoInterfaceNoIpVersion
methods.description: Test failure case when no interface or IP version specified.

methods.name: SetIPSettings_StaticIPv4
methods.description: Test setting static IPv4 IP configuration.

methods.name: SetIPSettings_WiFi
methods.description: Test setting IP configuration for WiFi interface.

methods.name: SetIPSettings_InvalidInterface
methods.description: Test setting IP with an invalid interface name.

methods.name: SetIPSettings_InvalidIPVersion
methods.description: Test setting IP with an unsupported IP version.

methods.name: SetIPSettings_IPv6NotSupported
methods.description: Test setting IPv6 IP configuration when not supported.

methods.name: SetIPSettings_InvalidPrefix
methods.description: Test setting IP with an invalid prefix length.

methods.name: SetIPSettings_InvalidIPFormat
methods.description: Test setting IP with invalid IP address format.

methods.name: SetIPSettings_SameIPAndGateway
methods.description: Test when IP address and gateway are identical, which should fail validation.

methods.name: SetIPSettings_DifferentBroadcastDomain
methods.description: Test IP and gateway outside the same broadcast domain scenario.

methods.name: SetIPSettings_IPEqualsBroadcast
methods.description: Test when IP address equals the broadcast address.

methods.name: SetIPSettings_GatewayEqualsBroadcast
methods.description: Test when gateway equals the broadcast address.

methods.name: SetIPSettings_APICallFailed
methods.description: Test failure in the API call for setting IP configuration.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan_Success
methods.description: Successfully start WiFi scan and mock response.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan_Failed
methods.description: Test failure when starting WiFi scan.

methods.description: Test failure when stopping WiFi scan.

methods.name: GetKnownSSIDs_Success
methods.description: Retrieve list of known SSIDs successfully.

methods.description: Add a new SSID to known list successfully.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSID_Success
methods.description: Remove SSID from known list successfully.

methods.name: WiFiConnectEAP_Success
methods.description: Connect to WiFi with EAP credentials successfully.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_Success
methods.description: Retrieval of connected SSID details successful, including signal and BSSID.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_Success_noise_9999
methods.description: Test handling of noise value at boundary condition (9999).

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_Success_noise_100
methods.description: Test handling of noise value at boundary condition (-100).

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_Success_noise_50
methods.description: Test handling of intermediate noise value.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_Failed
methods.description: Failure to retrieve connected SSID info.

methods.name: StartWPS_WIFI_WPS_PIN_Success
methods.description: WPS pairing with PIN method successfully.

methods.name: StartWPS_WIFI_WPS_SERIALIZED_PIN_Success
methods.description: WPS pairing with serialized PIN method successfully.

methods.description: Failure scenarios for obtaining public IP via STUN.

methods.description: Retrieve current STUN server endpoint configuration.

methods.name: SetStunEndpoint_InvalidParams
methods.description: Test setting STUN with invalid parameters.

methods.name: ConfigLineEmpty
methods.description: Test handling repeated configuration line issues during initialization.

methods.name: ComLinkEmpty
methods.description: Test behavior when the ComLink instantiate function returns null.

methods.name: platformInit
methods.description: Test platform specific initialization routines involving bus init and connect.

methods.name: GetConnectivityTestEndpoints
methods.description: Retrieve default and configured connectivity test endpoints.

methods.description: Successfully set new connectivity test endpoints.

methods.name: SetConnectivityTestEndpoints_Empty
methods.description: Test handling of empty endpoints array during setting.
